contracts.commit_point: Tool-call interception inside the create_agent middleware chain, ahead of tool-handler execution, triggered from the react_agent.ainvoke dispatches in WeChatAgent.ainvoke and WeChatAgent.astream.
contracts.declared_mechanism: ToolCallLimitMiddleware(thread_limit=1) instantiated in WeChatAgent.setup_middlewares and returned in the middleware list passed to create_agent (middleware=self.middlewares), intercepting each tool call ahead of handler execution.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Execution of more than one tool call within a single thread by the WeChatAgent ReAct agent (thread_limit=1 exceeded), covering plugin tools (WeChatTools) and MCP tools alike.

contracts.protected_operation: Tool invocation dispatch of the WeChatAgent ReAct agent (self.tools = plugin_tools + mcp_tools) during react_agent.ainvoke.
contracts.protected_resource: WeChatAgent tool-execution path bound via create_agent(model=self.model, tools=self.tools, middleware=self.middlewares).
contracts.protection_obligation: WeChatAgent tool-call limit: the WeChatAgent ReAct agent must not execute more than one tool call per thread; ToolCallLimitMiddleware(thread_limit=1), registered in the agent's middleware chain, must intercept every tool invocation before the tool handler executes.
scope_limits: Coverage is limited to the tool-invocation count at the middleware boundary; downstream external effects of individual WeChatTools/MCP tools are separate strata not classified by this contract.
WorkSpaceSimpleAgent registers no ToolCallLimitMiddleware (only handler_call_mcp_tool); the thread_limit=1 obligation is sourced only for WeChatAgent.
Thread-identity semantics of thread_limit are library-internal and not shown in supplied source.
